narrator.name: IOTA (SN9)
narrator.role: Subnet team: decentralised LLM pretraining on Bittensor subnet 9
narrator.one_line: Macrocosmos's pretraining subnet, relaunched as IOTA in June 2025, which speaks in the foundation's founding-mission register and calls Bittensor an incentivisation network and a global incentives machine.

statements.quote: The pre-training subnet (SN9), is at the heart of Bittensor's vision. Pre-training is the crucial first step in the creation of all modern AI models, where enormous amounts of data and computational power are consumed by the model in order for it to begin to understand the world.
statements.context: Steffen Cruz and Will Squires on the Macrocosmos Substack, announcing larger parameter counts on subnet 9.

source.title: Subnet 9: Scaling up parameters to further Bittensor's founding mission

statements.quote: Today on SN9, the pre-training process is distributed between highly skilled teams which compete to continuously improve models and get paid to do so. As a result SN9 produces world class large language models (LLMs) that are truly open: open source, open data, open models, open competition.
statements.context: The same post describing how subnet 9 worked in its competition phase.

source.title: Subnet 9: Scaling up parameters to further Bittensor's founding mission

statements.quote: There is this sort of constellation effect, of you needing lots and lots of pieces of the AI process to be really effective in this space, and in Bittensor. Ultimately, the network needs lots of these commodities to be super valuable. And so we saw a lot of harmony between building more than one of them
statements.context: Will Squires on the Novelty Search podcast, as excerpted by Macrocosmos on its own Substack, explaining why the team runs several subnets.

source.title: Co-founders Will and Steffen discuss the Macrocosmos Ecosystem on the Novelty Search podcast
source.outlet: Novelty Search (Opentensor Foundation), via Macrocosmos Substack

statements.quote: Subnet 9 proved decentralized LLM pretraining is viable. We are proud to release the technical primer for IOTA in advance of mainnet launch on June 2nd.
statements.context: Macrocosmos on X announcing the IOTA technical primer ahead of mainnet, as shown in a search result snippet.

statements.quote: Subnet 9 is now the home to the world's first ever model parallel and data parallel incentivized trustless pretraining protocol
statements.context: Macrocosmos Substack post announcing IOTA on subnet 9.

source.title: IOTA: Bittensor's biggest pretraining breakthrough is here

statements.quote: Swarm refers to multiple nodes working towards the same goal - but IOTA harnesses Bittensor to overcome the challenges of trustless incentivization and reward
statements.context: The IOTA announcement post explaining the swarm term and what Bittensor adds.

source.title: IOTA: Bittensor's biggest pretraining breakthrough is here

statements.quote: IOTA is also a significant step towards Bittensor's original intention of creating a competitive, decentralized alternative to proprietary models
statements.context: The IOTA announcement post placing the subnet in Bittensor's founding story.

source.title: IOTA: Bittensor's biggest pretraining breakthrough is here

statements.quote: participants around the globe join permissionlessly, but they all come together to build modular models and get rewarded as a collective

statements.quote: In August 2024, Bittensor's Subnet 9 (SN9) demonstrated that a distributed network of incentivized, permissionless actors could each pretrain large language models (LLMs) ranging from 700 million to 14 billion parameters, while surpassing established baselines.
statements.context: Abstract of the IOTA technical primer on arXiv by Quinque, Aboudib, Fonau, Lopez Portillo Alcocer, McCrindle and Cruz of Macrocosmos.

source.title: Incentivised Orchestrated Training Architecture (IOTA): A Technical Primer for Release

statements.quote: Our current north star for IOTA is to make our system indistinguishable for training purposes from centralised alternatives.

foundation.mission.summary: Subnet 9 is presented as the heart of Bittensor's vision and IOTA as a step toward Bittensor's original intention of a decentralised alternative to proprietary models.

foundation.vision.summary: The goal is a system indistinguishable for training from centralised alternatives, so anyone anywhere can help train a frontier model.

foundation.values.summary: Truly open: open source, open data, open models, open competition; later, permissionless joining and reward as a collective.

opportunity.summary: dTAO and owner alpha are read as Bittensor's edge, letting teams stay aligned with token holders instead of splitting incentives with equity.

audience.summary: Anyone with compute, anywhere, is invited to contribute to training.

positioning.category.summary: Bittensor is an incentivisation network and a global incentives machine; the subnet is a pretraining protocol.

positioning.differentiator.summary: The world's first model parallel and data parallel incentivised trustless pretraining protocol.

positioning.against.summary: Set against proprietary models and centralised labs.

value.functional.summary: World class open LLMs produced by paid competing teams, then a way to train without hosting the whole model.

value.self_expressive.summary: Joining means being part of a globe-spanning collective that trains a frontier model.

messaging.h1.summary: The world's first incentivised trustless pretraining protocol, and the claim that subnet 9 proved decentralised pretraining viable.

messaging.proof.summary: Proof is the August 2024 result: permissionless actors pretraining models from 700 million to 14 billion parameters above baselines.

voice.summary: Squires writes as a steward speaking to token holders, in a considered register about the protocol as a whole.

relationship.summary: Macrocosmos speaks as a multi-subnet team that sees the protocol as more than the sum of its parts and as experts in incentive design.

language.term.summary: Swarm, constellation effect, IOTA, and the commodity vocabulary borrowed from the foundation.

subnet.self.summary: Subnet 9 is the heart of Bittensor's vision, then the home of the first trustless swarm pretraining protocol where participants are rewarded as a collective.

subnet.network.summary: Macrocosmos speaks in the foundation's founding-mission register, calling Bittensor an incentivisation network, a global incentives machine, and a network of commodities whose edge is alignment with alpha holders.

coinages.meaning: Incentivised Orchestrated Training Architecture, the swarm pretraining protocol on subnet 9
the need for many pieces of the AI process, and many commodities, for the network to be valuable

genealogy.summary: In 2024 subnet 9 was described in the foundation's own register: the heart of Bittensor's vision [sn9-001], skilled teams competing and paid to produce truly open models [sn9-002]. Squires explained the multi-subnet strategy as a constellation effect built on commodities [sn9-003].

With IOTA in mid 2025 the frame moved from competition to swarm and collective reward [sn9-006] [sn9-008], while Bittensor became an incentivisation network [sn9-009] and a global incentives machine [sn9-012]. Squires framed dTAO as Bittensor's unique edge [sn9-010] and set the north star as parity with centralised training [sn9-015].
genealogy.shift: from competing teams to a cooperating swarm; the network becomes an incentives machine

relations.note: Frames IOTA as fulfilling Bittensor's original intention, the foundation's founding-mission story
